the crushing
the destruction that destroys destruction
Fracture descends; pulverisation ascends. Mula's ruin ruins ruin: demolition applied to what is itself destructive. The wheel's exorcism engine — and aimed by no one, it levels indiscriminately.
Root-work — taking the problem apart to its actual root; demolition that clears ground for the buildable.
The aimed razing — destroying the destroyer: the addiction, the tyranny, the pattern, uprooted whole with both hands.
Unaimed demolition — a life that razes itself in cycles; or the wrench turns inward and uproots its own foundations each time something grows.
What destructive thing in your life could this strength be aimed at — instead of at your own roots?
Purva Ashadha
varchograhana
the power of invigoration
strength
connection
luster
Force descends; relationship ascends. The invincible early declaration produces luster only when the strength is connected. Unconnected strength is mere pressure.
The invigorating declaration — the early oath that strengthens everyone who hears it to attempt what they haven't yet done.
The strategic overclaim — the conscious feint, the declared victory deployed to bridge a real gap, with full knowledge of the wager.
The pitch pitches itself — declarations inflate unbidden, memory edits toward the teller, luster borrowed against a harvest never brought in.
Your boldest current claim — who does it strengthen besides you?
Uttara Ashadha
apradhrishya
the power of unchallengeable victory
the strength that can win
the goal that can be won
the victory no one contests
Capacity descends; the right-sized aim ascends. Unchallengeable victory is not maximal victory — it is the perfect fit of strength to a genuinely winnable goal.
The fitted campaign — conduct, work, and aim matched so precisely that the position simply cannot be taken.
The refused contest — declining every battle over what needs no defence; victory by not arriving at the arena.
Contesting everything or nothing — strength spent on unwinnable ground, or winnable goals declined for fear the victory would be tested.
Name a goal you could actually, fully win. Why aren't you aimed at it?
Shravana
samhanana
the power of connection
the seeking
the paths
the connection of all things
The quest descends; the network of ways ascends. Shravana connects by hearing — the ear finds the path the eye cannot. Seeking that will not listen walks past every one of them.
The attentive climb — advancement made of heard paths, allies actually listened to, the teaching received before it is transmitted.
The severed line — breaking a connection that binds to a floor; the formal release of an outgrown patron, teacher, or path.
The ear closes or floods — hearing only the upward paths and going deaf to the people on them; or listening endlessly, connected to everything, committed along nothing.
What did you hear — actually hear — and who are you passing it to?
Dhanishta
khyapayitri
the power to give abundance and renown
birth
prosperity
the world's wealth gathered into one place
Emergence descends; increase ascends. The drum sounds because it is hollow. What is born prospers only if the vessel stays uncluttered enough to ring.
The sounded measure — the new thing born and drummed so the many can dance to it; abundance distributed as rhythm.
The tightened skin — deliberate constraint added to force resonance; austerity as instrument-making; fame declined so the hollow stays hollow.
The drum stuffs itself — accumulation deadens the tone; renowned and unresonant, prosperous and unheard.
What would you have to empty out for your life to ring again?
Shatabhisha
bheshaja
the power of healing
the pervasion over all things
the support
the world freed of calamity

Medicine descends as pervasion — healing that soaks through everything at once; support ascends as the vessel that holds the patient while it works. All pervasion with no support dissolves the patient.
The held immersion — the container built inside which the pervading medicine can work; witnessing as suture.
The sealed archive — what has been heard kept from those who would misuse it; the circle closed on purpose.
Pervasion without a vessel — every wound in the field soaks into the healer; or the circle seals so tight it becomes the calamity it was drawn against.
You absorb everything — what holds you while it works through?
Purva Bhadrapada
yajamana-udyamana
the power to raise the sacrificer
what is good for all beings
what is good for the gods
the support of the entire world
Two goods that do not automatically coincide, and a fire that must serve both at once. Does the fire lift the sacrificer, or consume the neighbourhood?
The aimed fever — intensity consciously fuelled and offered on the double altar.
The deliberate fast — a hunger starved on purpose so the flame purifies instead of spreads; the revolution banked underground until the season of burning.
The fire jumps the altar — zeal serves neither pole, only its own heat; upraised by intensity and stranded on the pillar, one-footed.
Your current burning conviction — name one being it concretely serves, and one god.
Uttara Bhadrapada
varshodyamana
the power to bring rain
the raining clouds
the growing plants
the stability of the three worlds
Release descends as rain; reception ascends as growth; their steady meeting stabilises worlds. The result is not abundance or victory — it is stability, the rarest yield on the wheel.
The steady rain — warmth, resources, presence delivered as reliable climate; depth that irrigates without demonstration.
The withheld season — the deliberate drought that renegotiates a one-sided bargain; the serpent's stillness as leverage.
The weather runs the house — moods rain or withhold ungoverned; stability purchased by one person's endless small payments.
Can the people you love plant by your weather?
Revati
kshiradyapani
the power of nourishing milk
the cows
the calves
the nourishment of the whole world
Source descends; need ascends; milk is their meeting. The last mansion's task is to see that everything gets fed before the crossing. Milk in the cow feeds no one; the shepherd counts heads.
The completed provisioning — grace as logistics, everyone fed, everything escorted to the far bank.
The withdrawn teat — the deliberate weaning; milk refused to what bites the feeding hand or should be grazing on its own by now.
The shepherdess starves — everyone fed but her; or the crossing hoarded against, provisions stockpiled for a journey never begun.
Everyone you're responsible for is fed. Who feeds you — and when do you cross?
NAKSHATRA: A jolt of starting. Speed before deliberation; the body moves first.
Bearing and containment. Pressure held until it ripens or breaks.
Cutting heat. The clean separation that hurts and clarifies at once.
Fertile density. Sap rising; the pleasure of accumulating substance.
Restless seeking. The scent of something not yet found.
Storm and clearing. Grief that scours rather than settles.
Return. The safety of coming back to a place already known.
Nourishment given. Steady milk; the most sheltering ground there is.
Coiled interior pressure. Wound tight, watching, capable of strike.
The weight of the dead behind the seat. Borrowed authority.
Rest and pleasure taken deliberately. The interval before work resumes.
Contract and patronage. Warmth that comes with an obligation attached.
Dexterity. What the hand can hold, it can also conceal.
Made brilliance. Form worked until it gleams.
Independent motion. Bending without breaking, and without anchor.
Forked purpose. Two goals held until one must be chosen.
Devotion that survives distance. Friendship as a discipline.
Seniority and its cost. Protection given from a position that isolates.
Root exposure. The ground pulled up to see what is actually holding.
Invincible conviction. Water that will not be argued with.
Late and permanent victory. Slow ground that does not give back.
Listening as a practice. Learning by transmission, not by invention.
Rhythm and wealth. The body kept in time by an external beat.
Enclosure and remedy. Healing that happens in isolation.
Burning idealism. Fire at the edge of the world, not warming anything.
Depth kept still. The serpent at the bottom, holding.
Safe passage and ending. Being carried across the last stretch.
NAK_DEEP: β and γ Arietis — two faint stars close together, the horse's two ears
Compact and springy. Weight forward on the balls of the feet, so standing still looks temporary. Quick head-turns. The whole frame reads as though it has just arrived or is about to leave.
Bright eyes set slightly wide, a broad clear forehead, and a strong hairline. The face registers before it composes — expression arrives ahead of intention.
First response. Emergency, rescue, the opening move, medicine given before the illness organises.
Arrives everywhere first and finishes nothing. Speed used to avoid the slower feeling underneath it.
35, 39 and 41 Arietis — a small triangle, the yoni
Substantial through the middle. Slow to move and hard to move once moving. Stands with weight evenly planted, and tends to occupy more room than the frame strictly requires.
Full features, a heavy or well-defined mouth, and eyes that hold contact a beat longer than is comfortable. Strong brows.
Bearing what must be carried. Birth, death, thresholds, the work nobody volunteers for.
Holds what should have been released. Endurance becomes a way of not deciding.
the Pleiades — six or seven stars in a tight cluster, the flame's edge
Erect and slightly forward-leaning, like something ready to cut. Sharp shoulders, deliberate hands. Movement is economical — no gesture is wasted, which reads as either elegance or impatience.
A defined jaw and a direct, narrow gaze. Fine, often unruly hair. The face has edges rather than curves, and the edges show under stress.
Cutting, cooking, refining, criticism that improves. Fire applied with a purpose.
Cuts what did not need cutting. The blade stays out because putting it away feels like losing.
Aldebaran — one red star, the brightest in the region, the red one

Well-proportioned and comfortable in the body. Moves smoothly, sits easily, and has an unhurried quality that other people read as confidence whether or not it is. Ages into fullness rather than out of it.
Even features, a warm and mobile mouth, and eyes with a settled quality. Good hair, and generally a face that photographs better than it feels from inside.
Growing things. Cultivation, beauty, whatever needs steady conditions and time.
Waters everything, chokes the garden. Attachment to what has been fed.
λ, φ1 and φ2 Orionis — three faint stars, the deer's head
Slight and alert. Head often tilted as though listening. Restless hands and feet — the body keeps searching even when the person has stopped. Light on the ground.
Large watchful eyes, a narrow face, and delicate features that look younger than the age. The expression changes at speed and leaves little trace.
Searching. Research, scenting a thing out, finding what others walked past.
The search never returns. Everything is found and nothing is woven in.
Betelgeuse — one red giant, the teardrop
Uneven. Can look heavy one season and drawn the next — the body registers weather, internal and external. Movement comes in bursts with stillness between, rather than at a constant rate.
A face that holds strong feeling near the surface. Deep-set eyes, a furrow that arrives early between the brows, and a mouth that is expressive to the point of giving things away.
Effort through difficulty. Storms, crisis, the work that requires someone who can stay wet.
Perpetual weather. Exertion becomes an identity and the arrival is never felt.
Castor and Pollux — the twins, two bright stars side by side
Light-framed and adaptable. Carries little tension. Has a way of settling into any room quickly, and of leaving it without ceremony. Posture is easy rather than trained.
An open, pleasant face with a naturally kind resting expression. Clear eyes, often a slight smile at rest. Looks approachable before it looks anything else.
Return and restoration. Rebuilding, second attempts, coming home changed.
Rebuilds compulsively without asking what should return.
γ, δ and θ Cancri — a small faint cluster, the udder
Solid and settled. Broad through the chest or shoulders. Stands the way furniture stands — the body communicates that it is not going anywhere, which is most of why people bring things to it.
A calm, rather formal face. Steady eyes. Features that read as older and more responsible than the age, from fairly early on.
Nourishing and keeping. Ritual, teaching, the rite performed by someone actually present.
Officiates a life without attending it. Feeds everyone from a source nothing refills.
five stars in Hydra's head — a coil

Fluid and close-held. Moves without obvious effort and often without obvious noise. Tends to be more physically present than the frame suggests — people notice the arrival late and the departure not at all.
A penetrating, unblinking gaze that is the single most-remarked feature. Fine mobile mouth. The face gives away almost nothing it has not decided to.
Entwining. Hypnosis, intimacy, medicine at the right dose, anything requiring grip.
The coil runs unowned. Tightens when frightened and calls it closeness.
Regulus — one bright star, the throne
Rat (male) · pairs with Purva Phalguni's rat

Upright, and formal even at rest. Carries the head level. Enters a room as though the room has been expecting it — sometimes correctly. Slower, more deliberate movement than the neighbours on either side.
A face with weight to it. Strong bone structure, a level and unhurried gaze, features that suggest lineage more than individuality. Ages well and looks like its relatives.
Occupying a seat. Leadership by inheritance, tradition, ancestral work.
Sits a throne it never mourned the last occupant of, and cannot say whose voice is giving the orders.
δ and θ Leonis — two stars, the front legs of the bed
Relaxed and physically at ease, with a distinct disinclination to hurry. Sits well. The body reads as something that expects to be enjoyed rather than used.
A warm face, an easy and frequent smile, and eyes that crinkle. Attractive in a way that is more about expression than structure.
Pleasure that begets. Courtship, creation approached as delight, rest taken properly.
Pleasure loops without issue. Entertained in a locked room.
Denebola — one star, the back legs of the bed
Bull (male) · pairs with Uttara Bhadrapada's bull
Sturdy and reliable-looking, with good posture that appears to cost nothing. Steady gait. Neither fast nor slow — the pace does not change much regardless of what is happening.
A composed, symmetrical face. Direct but not aggressive gaze. Looks trustworthy, which is occasionally inconvenient.
Covenant. Alliance, contract, the union whose terms are counted honestly.
Funds the union alone and calls the resentment love.
five stars in Corvus — a hand, or a fist
Neat and well-coordinated. Notably good hands — this is the one physical marker the classical sources are consistent about. Precise small movements. The body is competent rather than imposing.
A quick, intelligent face. Alert eyes, often a slightly amused set to the mouth. Features on the finer side, and hands that draw the eye.
Craft. Skill, dexterity, the patient procedure that closes the gap between wanting and holding.
Grasps. The hand closes on debris, or seeks with the fingers already clenched.
Spica — one brilliant star, the jewel

Striking rather than merely well-made. Carries itself with an awareness of being looked at — which reads as poise or as performance depending on the day. Good proportion, and usually a deliberate way of dressing the frame.
The most visually arresting face on the wheel, and the sources say so plainly. Large eyes, strong and well-cut features. People remember it.
Making. Architecture, design, work where law and truth are both satisfied.
Builds facades and calls the maintenance a life.
Arcturus — one star standing alone, the independent one
Slender and mobile. Sways rather than plants. Rarely still, but the movement is loose rather than driven. Tends to stand slightly apart in a group without appearing to have chosen to.
A pleasant, changeable face. Fine features, and an expression that shifts with the room's air. Something in the face is always slightly in motion.
Independent movement. Trade, negotiation, the wind that scatters so a thing can change form.
Substance scatters unchosen — attention strewn wherever the social wind blows.
four stars forming a gateway or an arch
Strong and forward-set, with a driven quality visible in the carriage. Leans in. Fixed gaze. The body reads as aimed at something even when at rest.
A determined face with strong brows and a set jaw. Eyes that focus hard. Attractive in an intense rather than an easy way.
Plowing and harvesting. Goal-directed effort, ambition with a named fruit.
Perpetual plowing. Breaks ground on field after field and is never present at a harvest.
three stars in Scorpio's body — a row, or a lotus
Balanced and unshowy. Good carriage without stiffness. Moves at a companionable pace — this is a body that walks alongside rather than ahead. Physically warm in manner.
A friendly, open face that people find easy to look at. Steady eyes. Nothing exaggerated; the impression accumulates rather than lands.
Devotion and friendship. Anything requiring both parties to travel toward each other.
Ascends toward friends and gods who never descend, and calls the ache loyalty.
Antares with two flanking stars — the eldest, an earring

Compact and contained, with more force in it than the size accounts for. Very still when still. Carries authority without display, and often looks like the oldest person in the room regardless of the facts.
A guarded, watchful face. Eyes that assess. Features that firm up early and change little afterwards.
Rank held for a purpose. Seniority, protection, the strike made on the clan's behalf.
Attacks what should be defended, defends what should be attacked. Seniority curdles into bitterness.
the stars at Scorpio's tail — a tied bunch of roots
Wiry and durable. Often thinner than expected. Movement is direct and slightly abrupt, without transitional softness. The body looks like it has been through something, fairly early.
An intense, stripped-back face. Deep eyes, prominent bone. The expression is uncompromising even at rest, which people read as depth or as difficulty.
Root work. Investigation, demolition of what is itself destructive, going to the bottom.
The wrench turns inward. Uproots its own foundations each time something finally grows.
δ and ε Sagittarii — two stars, a fan or a winnowing basket
Buoyant. Head up, chest open, and a way of moving that takes up air. Looks undefeated. The body is more resilient than careful — it recovers rather than avoids.
A bright confident face, an easy and rather winning smile, and eyes with a spark. Looks like someone worth backing.
Invigorating declaration. The early oath that strengthens everyone who hears it.
The pitch pitches itself. Luster borrowed against a harvest never brought in.
two stars in Sagittarius — an elephant's tusk, a planked bed
Mongoose (male) · has no pair — the only mansion without one
Solid, upright and unhurried. Good frame, well-held. Moves as though the destination is not in doubt. There is a settled quality that does not depend on the circumstances being settled.
A grave, well-formed face. Level gaze. Looks principled — and this is the mansion classical sources most associate with a face people instinctively trust.
The unchallengeable position. Conduct and aim matched so exactly that attack finds no purchase.
Contests everything or nothing. Strength spent on unwinnable ground for honour's sake.
three stars in Aquila — three footprints, or an ear
Monkey (female) · pairs with Purva Ashadha's monkey
Poised and slightly inclined, as though angled toward a sound. Quiet in movement. Often noticeably still while others are talking. Long-limbed more often than not.
An attentive face with prominent or well-shaped ears — the one feature the sources flag here. Eyes that watch the speaker's mouth. The expression is receptive rather than reactive.
Hearing. Learning, transmission, connection made by listening rather than reaching.
Hears only the upward paths and goes deaf to the people on them.
four stars in Delphinus — a drum
Lion (female) · pairs with Purva Bhadrapada's lion
Rhythmic. There is usually something percussive about the movement — tapping, a marked walking rhythm, a habit of moving to time. Well-built and physically capable. Holds a beat without meaning to.
A lively, well-defined face. Bright eyes and a strong mouth. Photographs as more animated than most, because it rarely holds one expression long.
Sounding. Music, rhythm, abundance distributed as measure, renown as resonance.
The drum stuffs itself. Accumulation deadens the tone.
a wide scattered group in Aquarius — a hundred physicians, an empty circle

Contained and slightly withdrawn. Stands a little further back than the conversation requires. Movement is unhurried and self-contained. There is often a marked physical boundary — a preference about distance that is felt rather than stated.
A private, composed face. Eyes that do not give access. Features can be striking but the expression is reserved, and the reserve is the first thing registered.
Systemic healing. Research, the held container, witnessing as suture, the sealed archive.
Pervasion without a vessel. Every wound in the field soaks in.
α and β Pegasi — two stars, the front legs of a funeral cot

Angular and slightly ascetic. Often tall or long through the limbs. Movement has an upward quality — the body carries itself as though the ground were provisional. Can look either austere or burning, rarely comfortable.
A distinctive face with a fixed, faintly otherworldly gaze. Strong features and a hollow under the cheek. The expression is intense in a way that does not soften much with familiarity.
Sacred intensity. The reformer, the ascetic, fire offered on the double altar.
The fire jumps the altar. Upraised by intensity and stranded on the pillar, one-footed.
γ Pegasi and α Andromedae — the back legs of the cot
Bull (female) · pairs with Uttara Phalguni's bull
Broad and grounded, with real physical depth. Slow, considered movement. The stillness is not tension — it is a body that is genuinely not in a hurry, which is rarer than it looks.
A deep, calm face. Eyes that are hard to read but not closed. Features that settle into gravity rather than sharpness. Reads as safe.
Steady rain. Depth that irrigates without demonstration; the climate a household can plant by.
The weather runs the house. Moods rain or withhold ungoverned.
thirty-two faint stars in Pisces — a drum, a fish
Soft-edged and gentle in motion. Light frame more often than not. Moves through a space without disturbing it. There is a slightly unanchored quality — present, but not entirely landed.
A sweet, open face with a gentle expression that people find calming. Eyes on the larger side, and a mouth that rests kindly. Looks younger than the age for a long time.
Provisioning the crossing. Grace as logistics, everyone fed, everything escorted to the far bank.
The shepherdess starves. Everyone is fed but her.
SIGN_FRAME: Aries
a lean, forward-set frame. Head leads — literally, in the walk. Sharp features, restless hands, and a wiry strength that does not read as bulk. Scars or marks about the head are traditional here.
Taurus
a solid, well-fleshed frame with a short strong neck and a settled stance. Moves slowly and is hard to shift. The face is broad through the cheek and the voice tends to carry weight.
Gemini
a tall or long-limbed frame, finely made. Quick hands, mobile face, and a way of standing that never quite settles. Looks younger than the age and stays looking it.
Cancer
a rounded, soft-edged frame that gains and loses through the middle. Broad chest or upper body. The face is full and the expression is unusually readable — feeling shows before speech.
Leo
an upright, large-boned frame with a notable head and hair. Broad shoulders, deliberate carriage. Occupies the centre of a space without appearing to intend it.
Virgo
a neat, contained frame, often on the slighter side. Precise movement, tidy hands. The face is fine-featured and looks intelligent before it looks anything else.
Libra
a well-proportioned, symmetrical frame — this is the sign the sources most associate with balance in the build. Graceful movement, pleasing face, and a marked ease in company.
Scorpio
a dense, powerful frame with more strength in it than the size suggests. Fixed gaze, controlled movement. The face gives away very little and the eyes are what people remember.
Sagittarius
a tall, long-thighed frame, well-made through the hips and legs. Open carriage, large gestures. A broad forehead and a face that laughs easily.
Capricorn
a lean, hard-wearing frame with prominent bone. Ages slowly and durably. Movement is economical; the posture can be guarded through the shoulders.
Aquarius
a tall or unusually proportioned frame — the sources say irregular, meaning distinctive rather than poor. Long limbs. Something in the look is memorably its own.
Pisces
a soft, well-covered frame with notable eyes and often notable feet. Fluid movement. The whole impression is gentler and less defined at the edges than the neighbours.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: The right to burn now — immediacy, all-at-once intensity.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Directed force; heat that lasts the winter.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: A life that feels pre-cooled; passion experienced as confiscated, erupting on its own schedule.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Chosen contact with fire — urgency, exertion, and heat taken on deliberately.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: Unbounded scale — the giant's appetite and reach.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Proportion; strength that fits through doorways.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Shame at being too much, felt as a verdict passed by others.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Raw magnitude on purpose — wilderness, heavy labour, big weather.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: Effortless plenty — being provided for without asking.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Cultivated abundance; the craft of exchange and increase.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Scarcity felt as betrayal; the grief that the world stopped feeding you.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Through the well — tend something until it yields, and let receiving be earned and felt.

VED_PLEDGE.grip: Chronic non-recognition; hunger for authority felt as a due denied.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Take a seat of real responsibility and keep its oaths where they can be seen.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: The unexamined common life — belonging without witness.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: The middle view; the witness-position among one's own kind.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Alienation felt as exile — the conviction of never having belonged anywhere.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Deliberate participation in the ordinary — wood, water, neighbours, the shared table.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: Something surrendered to the dead — a life not lived, a self laid down.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Depth-vision; the capacity to accompany endings without flinching.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Grief experienced as theft; hauntedness; endings arriving as ambushes.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Through the well — descent work, ancestor tending, funerals attended in full.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: Effortless shine — being the radiant one without craft.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Made light; precision of aim; beauty as workmanship.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Invisibility felt as injustice; hunger for glamour.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Make beautiful things slowly, and sign them.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: Rest and raw ore — unshaped time, the unmined self.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Mastery; the smith's hand; things that hold.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Toil felt as sentence — the conviction of never having been allowed to rest.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Return to the forge by choice, and honour fallow time as material rather than waste.

VED_PLEDGE.stake: The mercy of formlessness — oblivion, the right to dissolve.
VED_PLEDGE.sight: Form; a distinct self; memory that holds its shape.
VED_PLEDGE.grip: Overwhelm felt as drowning; the pull toward dissolution experienced as undertow rather than pledge.
VED_PLEDGE.walk: Through the well — chosen dissolution with a rope tied on: nidra, fast, and silence, followed by return.

BIFROST.sensation: Pressure at the top of the skull, or a cool draught where the fontanelle was.
BIFROST.aura: Wide and thin, extending upward and outward past the body's edge.
BIFROST.excess: Untethered — the room feels far away and instruction arrives without a sender.
BIFROST.deficit: Sealed. Nothing descends; decisions have to be manufactured.

BIFROST.sensation: A held tension between the brows; images arriving faster than words.
BIFROST.aura: Concentrated forward, a narrow cone in front of the face.
BIFROST.excess: Certainty that outruns evidence. The picture forms and closes.
BIFROST.deficit: Fog. Knowing something matters without being able to name it.

BIFROST.sensation: A ring of constriction at the notch; the swallow before speaking.
BIFROST.aura: A collar, denser at the front, thinning at the nape.
BIFROST.excess: Speech spent before it was ready — saying it to find out what it was.
BIFROST.deficit: The full interior with no exit. Held so long it turns to ache.

BIFROST.sensation: Warmth at the sternum that spreads sideways rather than up.
BIFROST.aura: The largest field the body makes — toroidal, whole-body, measurable.
BIFROST.excess: Direction dissolved into everyone else's. Love without an axis.
BIFROST.deficit: Correct on paper, cold in the room. The bearing without the warmth.

BIFROST.sensation: Heat below the ribs; the drop or lift that arrives before the reason does.
BIFROST.aura: Pulsing rather than steady — it moves in a wave with its own period.
BIFROST.excess: The wave mistaken for the truth. Acting at the crest.
BIFROST.deficit: Flat. Reading everyone else's weather and none of your own.

BIFROST.sensation: A low hum in the pelvic bowl; the yes or no that answers before you finish asking.
BIFROST.aura: Dense, close to the skin, heaviest at the front of the hips.
BIFROST.excess: Working past the response. The forge lit with nothing to make.
BIFROST.deficit: Consent given from the head. Depletion that sleep does not repair.

BIFROST.sensation: Weight at the pelvic floor, or a drumming that will not let the body settle.
